discoveries: Terrain, fatigue, and route choice remain active constraints even when Greg is alone and highly motivated.

discoveries: Sampling and field notes preserve chain of custody and condition, so evidence can travel farther than Greg's personal interpretation.

discoveries: Professional value begins to compound through documentation and references rather than raw capability alone.

rejected_hot.label: character_caricature

discoveries: The support-work model broadens: connecting people, records, and specialist knowledge can create real value without Greg performing the specialist task himself.

discoveries: Artifacts and historical systems remain most useful when placed back into their operating context instead of treated as isolated magical loot.

discoveries: Lakeward gives Greg enough distance from immediate survival to compare body, magic, money, tools, information, and people as separate lanes rather than one heroic progression track.
The planning remains practical because every lane still has constraints and evidence requirements.

rejected_hot.label: pov_crowding
rejected_hot.finding: Turning the audit into a grand self-definition speech would overstate a deliberately workmanlike recalibration.

discoveries: The Three Rays reconstruction gives Greg a civic-scale version of support: infrastructure can externalize uncertainty and help ordinary people detect confident wrongness.
